Name: Simple Material-Free Crafting and Construction
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[size=4]Requested by Eli0630[/size]
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]Simple Material-Free Crafting and Construction[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[size=4]Open a searchable free-item menu with [b]Left Ctrl + F8[/b]. Choose an object, food or craftable, select a quantity and press [b]Receive[/b] to add it to your backpack.[/size]
[size=5]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#F2C879]⚒ Features[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]• Search by item name or ID, browse pages, and receive 1, 10 or up to 999 items within their stack limit.
• A full backpack refuses the transfer without replacing your items.
• Normal material costs, gold prices, construction times and recipe/building progression stay enabled by default.
• Optional switches enable material-free crafting, cooking or construction; instant new buildings/upgrades; free building gold costs; temporary recipe access; and building unlock bypasses.
• Choose the menu hotkey or a controller binding in settings. The menu and settings support the 12 game languages.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#8FDAC0]▶ Getting started[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Install SMAPI, extract SimpleMaterialFreeCraftingAndConstruction into Stardew Valley/Mods, and launch through SMAPI. Load a single-player save and press [b]Left Ctrl + F8[/b] while no other menu or dialogue is open.

Select an item, choose its quantity, then click Receive. Keyboard: arrows/Tab to move, Enter to select, Page Up/Down to change pages, Esc to close. Controller: D-pad to move, A to select, X to receive, shoulder buttons to change pages, B to close.

[b]Settings[/b]
In the free-item menu, choose Settings beside Close to adjust background brightness. Save keeps the change; Cancel discards it. Defaults returns the slider to the original parchment brightness before saving.

With Generic Mod Config Menu installed: title screen → Mod Options → Simple Material-Free Crafting and Construction. Change the keybind or switches, then save. Simple Mod Settings can also edit these registered settings and requires GMCM.

Without either settings menu, launch once, close the game, edit Mods/SimpleMaterialFreeCraftingAndConstruction/config.json and restart. The free-item menu itself does not require GMCM. Existing config choices are preserved; choose Default in GMCM to restore normal costs and the Ctrl + F8 binding.

To remove the mod, close the game and delete its folder. Received items, crafted goods and buildings remain ordinary saved game content.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]ℹ Requirements and scope[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]PC Stardew Valley 1.6 with SMAPI 4.4 or newer. GMCM and Simple Mod Settings are optional. This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested.

The item picker is single-player only and lists objects, food and big craftables. Weapons, clothing, furniture and special progression pickups are excluded.

Optional crafting/building switches target normal game menus. Workbench crafting, replacement crafting menus, farmhouse renovations and already pending construction are outside scope. Building upgrades still need their previous building; placement rules and access to the builder remain. Material-free cooking preserves owned seasoning, which must be present for its quality bonus. Other menu/cost mods may conflict; multiplayer is unverified.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#D8B4FE]✉ Bug Reports & Suggestions[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Include game/mod versions, platform, SMAPI log, relevant settings, expected and actual results, and reproduction steps. Add a screenshot or video when helpful. For suggestions, describe the change and how it would help.

Created by xSyy.[/size]
